item.title: DCHS Student Awarded Prestigious $100,000 Rudd Scholarship
item.description: A celebration filled the cafeteria at Dodge City High School today as one senior received the surprise of a lifetime.

item.title: Farmers can learn how to use drone spraying technology
item.description: SALINA — Field maintenance is one of Kansas agriculture’s most constant needs, and a new professional training through Kansas State University Salina — the premier drone educator in the region — will help agricultural producers learn how to use drone protect plants, manage weeds and pests and boost yields.

item.title: KDHE launches travel and health webpage
item.description: TOPEKA — The Kansas Department of Health and Environment (KDHE) has launched a new Travel and Health webpage to provide healthcare and public health partners with educational and clinical resources ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026TM.

item.title: K-State’s next-generation agriculture facility will be named Western Star Global Grain and Food Center
item.description: MANHATTAN — Kansas State University’s Global Center for Grain and Food Innovation will be renamed the Western Star Global Grain and Food Center in honor of J.J. Vanier by the next generation of families, following approval from the Kansas Board of Regents at its Feb. 11 meeting.

item.title: Lady Demons Qualify 10 for State After Fifth-Place Regional Finish
item.description: The Dodge City Lady Demons delivered a strong performance at the regional wrestling tournament, finishing fifth overall while qualifying 10 wrestlers for the upcoming state championships.

item.title: DCHS Students Get a Taste of Adult Life at Reality U
item.description: On Feb. 17, students at Dodge City High School traded textbooks for check registers as they stepped into the real world during the school’s annual Reality U event.

item.title: Mutual Aid Agreements Prove Critical in Fighting Fires Across Southwest Kansas
item.description: When a large fire breaks out in southwest Kansas, it rarely becomes the responsibility of just one department. Instead, sirens from multiple towns can often be heard responding — a direct result of mutual aid agreements that have become essential to protecting lives and property across the region.

item.title: Red Demons Wrestling Sends 14 to Regional Meet in Wichita
item.description: The Dodge City Red Demons wrestling team will be well represented at the regional tournament on Feb. 21 in Wichita, qualifying 14 wrestlers across a wide range of weight classes as the program continues to show depth and competitiveness late in the season.
